fundamentals.business_description: WSP Global Inc. is a leading engineering and professional services firm. It provides technical and strategic advisory services to clients in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Environment, Power & Energy, Resources, and Industry sectors. WSP has over 73,000 employees worldwide and is headquartered in Montreal.

latest_analysis.executive_summary: WSP Global is well-positioned to benefit from the global infrastructure investment cycle. The company's diversified end-market exposure and strong M&A track record support a premium multiple. Initiating a 3-5% TFSA position is warranted at current levels.
key_drivers: Infrastructure spending supercycle driven by energy transition and data centre build-out
M&A integration delivering synergies ahead of schedule

layer2_context.portfolio_fit_rationale: Not yet held — highest-conviction addition for TFSA given capital gains profile and low correlation to existing holdings.
